title: Full Stack Developer

Mikro servis mimarisi konusunda deneyimli Ölçeklenebilir ve güvenli API geliştirme konularında bilgili Event-driven mimari ve mesaj kuyruğu sistemleriyle çalışmış React.js ve Next.js teknolojileriyle frontend geliştirme deneyimine sahip Takım çalışmasına yatkın ve problem çözme yeteneği güçlü Web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda deneyimli Git, GitHub gibi versiyon kontrol sistemlerine hâkim Gereksinimler Bilgisayar mühendisliği, Yazılım mühendisliği, Elektrik-Elektronik mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerden mezun En az 2 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi olan İzmir ve çevresinde yaşayan Ne Sunuyoruz? title: Senior Java Backend Developer (E-Commerce)
description: ABOUT US BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş., which began operations in 1995 with 21 stores, is today the company with the highest market share in Turkey's organized retail sector. BİM's core principle is delivering essential food and consumer goods to customers at the highest quality and most competitive prices. As the first representative of the hard-discount model in Turkey, BİM offers a product range of approximately 900 items — the majority of which are its own private-label brands — through its retail stores operating across the country. In addition, BİM launched an online shopping service for non-food products via the BİM MARKET mobile application in late 2021. BİM continued its steady growth in 2024, opening 886 new domestic stores throughout the year to reach a total of 12,089 stores in Turkey by year-end. The company continues to develop while maintaining its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction alongside an effective cost management policy. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer to help build and scale the core services powering our e-commerce platform. targets Define and implement disaster recovery (DR), security, and observability practices Work closely with product and other teams to shape technical requirements Actively participate in code reviews, upholding quality and maintainability standards Act as a technical partner on complex problems and guide the team Document technical decisions and mentor less experienced engineers to strengthen knowledge sharing and technical alignment Qualifications 8+ years of backend development experience Experience with Java 21 and the Spring Boot / Spring Cloud ecosystem Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of daily development workflows Experience designing and running microservices in production (data modeling, API design, inter-service communication) Experience modeling complex business domains and designing bounded contexts using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Experience with event-driven architecture and distributed data consistency using Kafka or similar messaging platforms Experience with performance tuning, migration management, and high-volume data on PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) Experience with Redis for caching strategies, session management, and rate-limiting Experience with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch for search and filtering infrastructure Experience with container-based deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm Experience with observability practices, DR, and High Availability (HA) architecture Strong command of code quality, maintainability, test automation, and CI/CD practices Experience working on high-traffic systems (e-commerce, payments, banking, telecom, etc.) Experience with AWS services (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, S3)

title: Backend Engineer — Video İşleme ve Haberleşme Sistemleri
description: Backend Engineer — Video İşleme ve Haberleşme Sistemleri Yazılım ekibimizde gerçek zamanlı video ve veri işleme altyapılarının geliştirilmesinde görev alacak, backend geliştirme alanında en az 3 yıl, tercihen 5 yıl ve üzeri deneyime sahip, haberleşme sistemleri konusunda tecrübeli bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Sorumluluklar * Drone ve kamera sistemlerinden gelen canlı görüntü akışlarını entegre etmek. * Gerçek zamanlı video ve veri işleme altyapısını geliştirmek. * Computer Vision ekibiyle birlikte analiz modellerini backend servislerine entegre etmek. * Analiz sonuçlarının dashboard’a anlık aktarılmasını sağlamak. * Radyo bağlantıları üzerinden veri ileten cihaz ve sistemlerin yazılım entegrasyonlarını gerçekleştirmek. * Haberleşme protokolleri ve cihaz arayüzleri üzerinden veri alışverişini sağlamak. * Kapalı ağ ortamlarında çalışabilen servisler geliştirmek. * Bağlantı kesintileri, veri kaybı ve gecikme durumlarını yönetmek; sistem performansını izlemek ve iyileştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler * Backend geliştirme alanında en az 3 yıl profesyonel deneyim; tercihen 5 yıl ve üzeri. * Python, Go, C++ veya Java gibi dillerden en az birinde güçlü geliştirme tecrübesi. * Gerçek zamanlı veri akışları, asenkron işlemler ve API geliştirme konusunda deneyim. * TCP/IP, UDP ve WebSocket gibi ağ protokolleri ve iletişim teknolojilerine hâkimiyet. * RTSP, RTP veya benzeri video aktarım protokolleriyle çalışma deneyimi. * FFmpeg veya GStreamer gibi video işleme araçlarıyla uygulamalı deneyim. * Radyo modem, telsiz veya benzeri haberleşme cihazlarıyla yazılım seviyesinde entegrasyon deneyimi. * Linux, Docker, veritabanları ve mesaj kuyruklarıyla çalışma tecrübesi. * Küçük bir ekipte sorumluluk alabilen, bağımsız çalışabilen ve teknik karar süreçlerine katkı sağlayabilen. Tercih Sebepleri * Drone SDK’ları ve telemetri verileriyle çalışma deneyimi. * Kapalı ağ ve internet bağlantısı olmayan ortamlarda sistem kurulum ve işletim tecrübesi. * Sınırlı bant genişliğine sahip bağlantılarda veri aktarımı konusunda deneyim. * Gömülü sistemler, seri haberleşme veya cihaz protokolleriyle çalışma tecrübesi.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team and take ownership of designing, building, and evolving scalable backend systems. We expect senior engineers not only to write high-quality code, but also to understand the systems they build end-to-end, make sound technical decisions, improve engineering practices, and make effective use of modern AI and agentic development tools. Required Qualifications · 6+ years of professional software development experience , with substantial experience building backend systems. ·       Strong proficiency in Java and a solid understanding of object-oriented design, clean code principles, and common software design patterns. ·       Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and relevant Spring technologies such as Spring Data and Spring MVC. ·       Solid experience with JPA/Hibernate or similar persistence technologies. ·       Strong understanding of RESTful API design , HTTP, authentication, authorization, and integration patterns. ·       Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases , preferably PostgreSQL or similar production-grade database systems. ·       Good understanding of transactions, concurrency, database performance, and data modeling. ·       Experience designing and operating production backend systems with attention to performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance . ·       Practical experience with automated testing using tools such as JUnit, Mockito , and integration-testing frameworks. ·       Strong proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows based on branches, pull requests, and code reviews. ·       Comfortable working with Linux-based environments and command-line tools. ·       Experience investigating production problems using logging, monitoring, metrics, and tracing. ·       Ability to understand an existing codebase, identify architectural and technical issues, and propose pragmatic improvements. ·       Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools as part of the software development lifecycle. ·       Ability to critically review, test, and validate AI-generated implementations rather than relying on generated output without verification. ·       Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. ·       Strong sense of ownership and ability to work effectively in a fast-moving product development environment. Preferred Qualifications ·       Experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures . ·       Experience with messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ . ·       Experience with Docker, Kubernetes , or similar container and orchestration technologies. ·       Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure . ·       Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins , or similar tools. ·       Experience with build and dependency management tools such as Maven . ·       Familiarity with observability platforms and concepts including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting. ·       Understanding of application and API security principles. ·       Experience with caching technologies such as Redis . ·       Experience working with high-volume or data-intensive backend systems. ·       Familiarity with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, MCP, agentic workflows, or AI-enabled backend applications is a plus. ·       Experience improving engineering workflows using AI-assisted development, automated code review, or agent-driven testing is a plus. What We Value Beyond specific technologies, we value engineers who: ·       Take ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions. ·       Think about the system as a whole rather than only the code they are currently working on. ·       Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity. ·       Can balance engineering quality with the need to deliver. ·       Question assumptions and contribute constructively to technical decisions. ·       Use AI and automation to increase productivity while maintaining responsibility for the quality of the final result. ·       Enjoy learning new technologies and adapting their development practices as software engineering evolves.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: ABOUT THE TEAM At TOOLIGO, we are shaping the future of technology by building innovative and scalable solutions. From robust infrastructures to high-performance services, we create systems that empower our ecosystem and deliver seamless journeys for our users. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. Leveraging modern technologies and best practices, you will help shape our architecture, ensuring seamless integration across backend services, web interfaces, and mobile applications. Practical Knowledge: Proficient in OOP, Design Patterns, Clean Code, and Software Craftsmanship. Experienced in Refactoring processes. Backend Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in backend development, specifically with C# and the .NET ecosystem (including .NET 6/8+ and .NET Framework 4.x). Frontend Proficiency: Solid knowledge of Next.js and React; hands-on experience with state management using Redux and Context API / Providers. Language Skills: Good command of written and spoken English to follow technical documentation and global industry trends.
